Title: Disable Enemy Time Dilation
Description:
Performance optimization mod that prevents NPCs from using Time Dilation while keeping it available for the player.

  • Reduces lag from multiple Time Dilation activations
  • Player can still use Time Dilation normally
  • Safe to add to existing saves
  • Safe to remove
  • Compatible with other mods
  • Uses Harmony patching for reliability
